Comparing the **[Casper Original](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462782648065644,imageDocid:16797159748640366827,gpcid:2731998679142591627,headlineOfferDocid:12837960475889141426,catalogid:2520914256107107674,productDocid:4981364974461655363,rds:PC_2731998679142591627%7CPROD_PC_2731998679142591627&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCAwQAQ)** and the **[Casper Wave Hybrid](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:5000017997147271358,gpcid:12176442930494094863,headlineOfferDocid:1369711930134462533,catalogid:12956388533923650811,productDocid:14164213955172598077,rds:PC_13208393996921814186%7CPROD_PC_13208393996921814186&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCAwQAg)** comes down to `choosing between a streamlined, budget-friendly all-foam bed and a high-end, heavily-engineered luxury hybrid`.[[1]](https://www.mattressclarity.com/reviews/casper-vs-casper-wave-hybrid/)

### **At a Glance Comparison** 

| | |
|---|---|
| Type All-foam | Type Hybrid (Foam + Coils + Latex) |
| Height 11 inches | Height 13 inches |
| Firmness Medium-firm (~7/10) | Firmness Medium-firm (~6.5/10) |
| Feel Balanced, neutral foam (sleep "on/in" mix) | Feel Softer, plush, contouring |
| Cooling Standard AirScape perforation | Cooling Enhanced cooling gel + breathable coils |
| Target Budget Value / Mid-range | Target Budget Luxury / Premium |

### **Key Differences** 

- **Construction & Layers:** 
	- *[Casper Original](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462782648065644,imageDocid:16797159748640366827,gpcid:2731998679142591627,headlineOfferDocid:12837960475889141426,catalogid:2520914256107107674,productDocid:4981364974461655363,rds:PC_2731998679142591627%7CPROD_PC_2731998679142591627&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCEQBQ):* Features **3 layers** of foam (including a responsive top layer and a zoned transition/support foam) sitting on a durable foam base.
	- *[Casper Wave Hybrid](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:5000017997147271358,gpcid:12176442930494094863,headlineOfferDocid:1369711930134462533,catalogid:12956388533923650811,productDocid:14164213955172598077,rds:PC_13208393996921814186%7CPROD_PC_13208393996921814186&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCEQBw):* Features **5 layers of foam** plus a dedicated pocketed **innerspring coil layer** and thin latex layers, making it 2 inches thicker overall.[[1]](https://www.mattressnerd.com/casper-original-vs-casper-wave-hybrid-mattress-comparison/)[[2]](https://www.mattressclarity.com/reviews/casper-vs-casper-wave-hybrid/)
- **Support & Ergonomics (Zoned Support):** 
	- *[Casper Original](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462782648065644,imageDocid:16797159748640366827,gpcid:2731998679142591627,headlineOfferDocid:12837960475889141426,catalogid:2520914256107107674,productDocid:4981364974461655363,rds:PC_2731998679142591627%7CPROD_PC_2731998679142591627&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCEQDw):* Uses a simpler 3-zone foam layout to keep the spine aligned (softer under the shoulders, firmer under the hips).
	- *[Casper Wave Hybrid](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:5000017997147271358,gpcid:12176442930494094863,headlineOfferDocid:1369711930134462533,catalogid:12956388533923650811,productDocid:14164213955172598077,rds:PC_13208393996921814186%7CPROD_PC_13208393996921814186&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCEQEQ):* Uses a more complex ergonomic zoning system enhanced with **gel pods** underneath the waist and lower back for deeper, targeted alignment.[[1]](https://www.mattressclarity.com/reviews/casper-vs-casper-wave-hybrid/)
- **Feel & Pressure Relief:** 
	- *[Casper Original](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462782648065644,imageDocid:16797159748640366827,gpcid:2731998679142591627,headlineOfferDocid:12837960475889141426,catalogid:2520914256107107674,productDocid:4981364974461655363,rds:PC_2731998679142591627%7CPROD_PC_2731998679142591627&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCEQGQ):* Slightly firmer with a neutral, balanced feel. It is responsive and doesn't trap you in a deep hug.
	- *[Casper Wave Hybrid](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:5000017997147271358,gpcid:12176442930494094863,headlineOfferDocid:1369711930134462533,catalogid:12956388533923650811,productDocid:14164213955172598077,rds:PC_13208393996921814186%7CPROD_PC_13208393996921814186&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCEQGw):* Plush and softer, offering superior contouring and pressure relief for sensitive joints.[[1]](https://www.mattressclarity.com/reviews/casper-vs-casper-wave-hybrid/)[[2]](https://www.mattressnerd.com/casper-original-vs-casper-wave-hybrid-mattress-comparison/)
- **Temperature Regulation:** 
	- *[Casper Original](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462782648065644,imageDocid:16797159748640366827,gpcid:2731998679142591627,headlineOfferDocid:12837960475889141426,catalogid:2520914256107107674,productDocid:4981364974461655363,rds:PC_2731998679142591627%7CPROD_PC_2731998679142591627&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCEQIw):* Sleeps reasonably well, though all-foam can trap a bit more heat.
	- *[Casper Wave Hybrid](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:5000017997147271358,gpcid:12176442930494094863,headlineOfferDocid:1369711930134462533,catalogid:12956388533923650811,productDocid:14164213955172598077,rds:PC_13208393996921814186%7CPROD_PC_13208393996921814186&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCEQJQ):* Better for hot sleepers thanks to the airflow from the inner coils and specialized top cooling gel layers.[[1]](https://www.mattressnerd.com/casper-original-vs-casper-wave-hybrid-mattress-comparison/)
- **Motion Isolation vs. Edge Support:** 
	- *[Casper Original](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462782648065644,imageDocid:16797159748640366827,gpcid:2731998679142591627,headlineOfferDocid:12837960475889141426,catalogid:2520914256107107674,productDocid:4981364974461655363,rds:PC_2731998679142591627%7CPROD_PC_2731998679142591627&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCEQLQ):* Better at dampening motion transfer (great if you share a bed with a restless partner).
	- *[Casper Wave Hybrid](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:5000017997147271358,gpcid:12176442930494094863,headlineOfferDocid:1369711930134462533,catalogid:12956388533923650811,productDocid:14164213955172598077,rds:PC_13208393996921814186%7CPROD_PC_13208393996921814186&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCEQLw):* Superior edge support thanks to the reinforced hybrid coil perimeter.[[1]](https://www.mattressclarity.com/reviews/casper-vs-casper-wave-hybrid/)

### **Which One Should You Choose?** 

- **Go with the [Casper Original](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462782648065644,imageDocid:16797159748640366827,gpcid:2731998679142591627,headlineOfferDocid:12837960475889141426,catalogid:2520914256107107674,productDocid:4981364974461655363,rds:PC_2731998679142591627%7CPROD_PC_2731998679142591627&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCoQAw) if:** 
	- You want a reliable, comfortable bed without spending a fortune.
	- You prefer an all-foam feel that is slightly firmer and keeps you more on top of the mattress.
	- You are a combo sleeper or stomach sleeper who doesn't need specialized luxury pressure relief.[[1]](https://www.mattressclarity.com/reviews/casper-vs-casper-wave-hybrid/)
- **Go with the [Casper Wave Hybrid](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:5000017997147271358,gpcid:12176442930494094863,headlineOfferDocid:1369711930134462533,catalogid:12956388533923650811,productDocid:14164213955172598077,rds:PC_13208393996921814186%7CPROD_PC_13208393996921814186&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjssMqy64OYAxVzBtsEHXadKO8Qxa4PeggIAggBCCoQDQ) if:** 
	- You have a higher budget and want a true luxury-tier mattress.
	- You suffer from chronic lower back or hip pain and need advanced ergonomic zoning.
	- You sleep hot or prefer a softer, contouring surface (especially if you are a side sleeper or weigh a bit more).[[1]](https://www.mattressclarity.com/reviews/casper-vs-casper-wave-hybrid/)[[2]](https://www.mattressnerd.com/casper-original-vs-casper-wave-hybrid-mattress-comparison/)

You can explore current pricing, trial periods, and sizing details directly on the Casper Official Website or read independent deep-dives on [Mattress Clarity](https://www.mattressclarity.com/reviews/casper-vs-casper-wave-hybrid/).[[1]](https://www.mattressclarity.com/reviews/casper-vs-casper-wave-hybrid/)

Are you mostly **side, back, or stomach sleeping** , and do you have any specific **lower back or joint pain** you're hoping a new mattress will help with?

	- You have a higher budget and want a true luxury-tier mattress.
	- You suffer from chronic lower back or hip pain and need advanced ergonomic zoning.
	- You sleep hot or prefer a softer, contouring surface (especially if you are a side sleeper or weigh a bit more).[[1]](https://www.mattressclarity.com/reviews/casper-vs-casper-wave-hybrid/)[[2]](https://www.mattressnerd.com/casper-original-vs-casper-wave-hybrid-mattress-comparison/)
